mapper.sql: id, user_id, original_filename, file_size, content_type, file_hash, part_size, part_count, uploaded_count, bucket_name, object_key, status, expires_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_upload_session (user_id, original_filename, file_size, content_type, file_hash, part_size, part_count, uploaded_count, bucket_name, object_key, status, expires_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{originalFilename}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{fileHash}, #{partSize}, #{partCount}, 0, #{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE file_upload_session SET uploaded_count = #{uploadedCount}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INIT', 'UPLOADING')
UPDATE file_upload_session SET status = 'MERGING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INIT', 'UPLOADING')
UPDATE file_upload_session SET status = 'COMPLETED', object_key = #{objectKey}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INIT', 'UPLOADING', 'MERGING')
UPDATE file_upload_session SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_upload_session WHERE status IN ('INIT', 'UPLOADING') AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < NOW() ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE file_upload_session SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INIT', 'UPLOADING', 'MERGING', 'FAILED')
